_comment: Kiro MCP config for the Governed Agentic Companion cloud front door via the LOCAL BRIDGE. Kiro spawns frontdoor/mcp_bridge.py as a stdio MCP server; the bridge forwards to the deployed AgentCore runtime with a Cognito access token it mints + auto-refreshes. Copy the companion-engine entry into your workspace .kiro/settings/mcp.json (or ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json) and MERGE with any existing mcpServers. Set the absolute path to your clone and fill the env from your gitignored ~/.companion-frontdoor.env (see frontdoor/README.md) — never commit real secrets, ARNs, or account ids. Governance is unchanged: the bridge only relays; the runtime's response is already gated in the cloud; a human deploys (Tenet 1).
